text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Here.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a return, right? Fufu...
I thought you might be stopping by around now!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Chronicles of the Red-Haired King" and "Knight of the Scarlet Rose", all 18 volumes!
These two share the same universe,
so you just can't help binge-reading them, right!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, speaking of which, that book you requested
arrived! On the new arrivals shelf—

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: No, I'm fine for today...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day when selection races were held,
I noticed Zenno Rob Roy watching the track
with unusual intensity.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Do your best...! Just a bit more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her whispered cheers were directed toward a horse girl
pushing with all her might in the final spurt.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*WAAAAAAAH!*)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...9th place.
choice_data_list: Is she a friend of yours?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: She's a fellow book lover, you could say... She used to share my passion for reading...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's concerning that she speaks of it in the past tense. Just then, the girl she had been cheering for finished her race and walked past right in front of us.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to talk to her?
Aren't you going to talk to her?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I want to. But... I don't know if someone like me could even find the right words of encouragement...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy seems unsure of how to talk to her. But what truly matters is the genuine care and concern she feels for her friend.
choice_data_list: If she's a precious friend, you need to summon your courage!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Courage... Yes, you're right. I can't let myself be cowardly at a time like this...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm going to go talk to her!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy-san. ...You were watching my race?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry for intruding! I hadn't seen you in the library lately, so I got worried...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So it was because of the selection race. Um, I'll be waiting for you, whenever you're ready to come back...

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not going back anymore. I finally realized something.

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: While everyone else was pushing their limits with rivals and making supportive teammates, all I ever did was bury my nose in books.

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: If I wanted to take racing seriously, I should have spent my time blending in with everyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-That's not true at all—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry for raising my voice...! But it really isn't true!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's true that spending that time doing other things might have yielded different bonds and lessons.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But there are experiences you could only gain, and things you could only learn, precisely because you loved reading...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And there are encounters that only happened because of our love for books—

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, I'm sorry for speaking up out of nowhere! It's just, I love that book so much too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: N-No, you don't have to apologize! To tell the truth, I was hoping for someone to share my thoughts with!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "O friend, O brave one. Should trials ever befall thee, I swear I shall run beside thee—"

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...That's the quote from the book you were reading the first time we ever talked...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's a bond born from our shared love of books—so please, let me help you. Would you care to do some pace-matching training together?

text_block_list.name: Book-loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-san... Yeah! Thank you, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy and her friend ran onto the track. Their expressions were focused and determined, yet radiating brighter than ever before.
